issues.problem: The picture shows a person (a woman), so the natural question is "Who is this?". "What is this?" is wrong for a person. Scene 15 uses "Who is this?" correctly.

issues.quote: Emma: Mom. This is a mom.
issues.problem: "This is a mom" is unnatural. A child would say "This is my mom." or "This is Mom."
issues.fix: Emma: Mom. This is my mom.

issues.problem: The picture shows a person (grandpa with white hair and a cane), so the question should be "Who is this?".

issues.quote: Love đọc là lớp, giống chữ lờ rồi mở miệng nhẹ.
issues.problem: "lớp" ends in a p sound, and it is also a Vietnamese word meaning "class". English "love" ends in /v/ (upper teeth on the lower lip), so this hint teaches the wrong ending.
issues.fix: Love đọc là lớv: bắt đầu bằng lờ, rồi cuối từ đặt răng trên chạm môi dưới và thổi nhẹ như âm vờ.
